  "manipulation_or_predictor": "Stimulus type (composite faces versus composite line patterns with salient Gestalt information) combined with alignment and congruency manipulations in a complete composite task design.",
  "outcome_measure": "Response sensitivity (d') based on same/different judgments of the top parts of composite stimuli.",
  "population_and_setting": "22 participants from the University of Tübingen community tested in a laboratory setting.",
  "sample_size_total": 22,
  "recruitment_and_incentive": "Allowed 22 people to register and stopped data collection after testing all those who showed up; informed consent was obtained.",
  "analysis_plan": "A repeated measures ANOVA testing the main effects and interactions of alignment, congruency, and task, followed by tests of simple main effects (congruency effects within aligned and misaligned conditions).",
  "preregistered_or_confirmatory": "not stated",
  "other_methods_notes": "Participants completed two composite tasks (one with faces and one with line patterns, counterbalanced order) making same/different judgments about the top halves of sequentially presented stimuli separated by a mask."
